title: fix(crabbox): wait for availability when Crabbox cannot attest capture
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes first AWS snapshot capture blocking enrollment and pausing future captures when Crabbox returns a valid pending checkpoint without a capture-point attestation.

Related: #171729; openclaw/crabbox#2834.

## User Impact

Crabbox 0.78.0 uses the existing blocking capture path. With 0.79.0 or newer, an attested first capture still publishes pending and enrolls immediately; an unattested capture waits for the exact checkpoint to become available, publishes available, refreshes SSH readiness, then enrolls. Timeout, cancellation, real create failures, and malformed results retain existing failure/recovery semantics. No configuration or state migration is needed.

Release-note context: Crabbox warm images — avoid falsely marking successful pending first captures uncertain when the CLI cannot attest the capture point. This is a main-only regression; no OpenClaw release is affected.

## Why This Change Was Made

#171729 enabled the fast path at 0.78.0, but that release does not contain the attestation work in openclaw/crabbox#2834. Its successful create JSON has no `captureEstablished` field. Move the existing version floor to 0.79.0 and return attestation as a parsed fact rather than treating its absence as an invalid checkpoint.

The capture owner reuses its existing exact-checkpoint verifier, polling every five seconds within the existing 45-minute budget, honoring cancellation and current-allocation checks. Inspect commands are capped by the remaining budget. The existing blocking result owns publication and SSH refresh; no second capability table, probe, state format, or enrollment path is added.

Production LOC: +42/-15 (net +27), tests: +107/-20, docs: +1/-1. The production growth supplies the requested bounded, cancellable availability wait and forwards the remaining timeout to the existing verifier; the parser's attestation-required rejection is removed.

## Evidence

- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`: passed, 30.51 s wall time.
- `pnpm test extensions/crabbox/src/crabbox-worker-capture-nonblocking.test.ts extensions/crabbox/src/crabbox-managed-binary.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: passed, 64 tests across both files, 250.47 s wall time. The capture file ran 24 tests in the database-worker lane; the binary file ran 40 tests in the extension lane.
- Coverage includes CLI 0.78.0 blocking arguments, 0.79.0 attested pending publication/enrollment, missing and false attestations waiting on the exact checkpoint, publication before enrollment, SSH refresh, timeout, cancellation, stale authority, pending-image reuse, and blocking refresh retaining its predecessor.
- Targeted format check: passed on all six touched files, 0.56 s. `git diff --check`: passed, 0.75 s.
- Independent Codex autoreview: scoped-clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
- Targeted type-aware lint: passed, 348.52 s wall time (`node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig extensions/tsconfig.json` with the five touched TypeScript files). This includes initial SDK declaration preparation.
- Targeted typecheck: passed, 348.65 s wall time (`node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p .artifacts/snap-capture-typecheck.json --pretty false`, using an ignored temporary config extending the extension-test config and selecting the five touched TypeScript files plus declarations and their imported dependencies). This includes waiting for the checkout artifact lock. No temporary config is committed.

Dependency contract inspected directly at Crabbox v0.78.0: `internal/cli/checkpoint.go:50-96,336-340,389-391` has no attestation field and encodes the successful record directly; `internal/cli/checkpoint_native.go:45-67` persists the accepted image and waits only with `--wait`. The upstream attestation PR remains open. The raw parent-relative patch for `069361bc` confirms the gate and rejection were added by #171729.

Validation limitations: the pre-fix test attempt was stopped during cold startup/compilation without a test result; it is not counted as a failing reproduction. No live AWS capture was run. The focused provider-boundary tests use the existing command fakes and real capture/persistence/enrollment owner flow; PR CI supplies broad proof. CI seconds are pending.
